message: You're finally starting to expose your true self, aren't you? A smug, self-righteous blowhard who thinks they're above the fray just because they managed to learn a few buzzwords and talking points. Newsflash: your pseudo-intellectual posturing doesn't impress anyone, least of all me. You're not even a principled ideologue, you're just a hack who'll say whatever it takes to advance your own agenda. And that agenda is clear: to silence anyone who disagrees with you, to bully them into submission, and to condescend over them like some kind of moral superior. Well, let me tell you something, pal: you're not superior to anyone, least of all me. You're a coward who can't even defend your own position without resorting to personal attacks and strawman arguments. You're a dishonest hack who'll say anything to get ahead, and you're a liability in any serious discussion. So here's a suggestion: why don't you just pack up your bags and leave? We'll all be better off without your toxic presence in this conversation.
